text: あいつら　には　こまってたんだ　あなたの　ポケモンが　きずついちゃったね

structure.en: we were being troubled, you see

structure.jp: あなたの　ポケモンが

structure.en: ended up getting hurt, didn't they

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says a state is going on; in casual speech the い drops, and た puts it in the past. こまってた = 'had been troubled'.

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう says the thing went and happened, often to your regret; ちゃう is its casual short form. きずついちゃった = 'ended up getting hurt'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ (short for のだ) gives the feeling of explaining how things stand. こまってたんだ = 'we were having trouble, you see'.
